steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Quadratic graph: A U-shaped curve called a parabola. The equation is y = ax² + bx + c. | Key features: Roots (x-intercepts): Where the curve crosses the x-axis (y = 0) y-intercept: Where the curve crosses the y-axis (x = 0) Turning point: The vertex (minimum or maximum point) Line of symmetry: Vertical line through the turning point

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Find the y-intercept of y = x² - 4x + 3. | Find the roots of y = x² - 9. | Find the roots of y = x² - 5x + 6.
